thread:
anya: Heads up — I opened a docs PR to refresh the HelloApp quickstart for SDK v10. It swaps the old auth snippet for ephemeral keys and adds a containerized deploy example. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/452
sam: Nice! Did you include the env var examples for both mac/linux and windows? The old snippet broke on Windows.
anya: Yep — added both. Example:
```bash
# mac/linux
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="${REDWOOD_API_KEY}"
# windows (powershell)
$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = "<key>"
```
kai: One thing — the quickstart still links to /examples/hello-old which 404s. I added a TODO to the PR, can we point it to the new starter repo?
docs-bot: Reminder: PR 452 labeled docs/quickstart and awaiting review from @sam and @jordan
sam: I'll review today. Also can we add a tiny CI smoke test to ensure `curl` example returns 200? I can add a github action snippet.
jordan: agree. Small note on auth: ephemeral keys expire in 5m by default, call that out — caught a support ticket last week.
anya: Good catch. I'll add a footnote and a "Troubleshooting: token expired" section. Also adding a short local debugging tip:
```bash
# quick sanity check
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.example/v1/hello
```
sam: Perfect. Once CI action is in place and link fixed, I'll approve.
docs-bot: @ci-bot queued a dry-run for PR 452 — results will post in the PR when done :gear:
ci-bot: Dry-run passed (lint + linkcheck), but linkcheck flagged a relative link in guides/setup.md
anya: I'll patch guides/setup.md to use absolute path to /starter/hello-v10. Thanks all — assigning follow-ups:
- @anya: update PR with token footnote + link fix
- @sam: add GH action smoke test
- @jordan: queue brief customer-facing note about ephemeral key TTL
Let's sync tomorrow if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
